column1: # Partition table for the 4 MB ESP32 on the relay controller.
# The default "single app" layout gives the application only 1 MB
# firmware had filled to 97% (3% free) once the dispensing architecture
# web API and its embedded control page landed. A nearly-full app partition is
# a build-time warning today and a boot failure the moment enough is added
# the application gets 3 MB here instead.
